title: FlowDoc Bounded Browser Compatibility Promotion Checklist

items.label: Capture current FlowDoc, Core, Editor, Backend, and Project Control map/evidence state before promotion.
items.evidenceTarget: Current node truth states, FlowDoc system map wording, and accepted browser smoke evidence are reviewed before edits.
items.verificationNote: Reviewed FlowDoc system map, document-map operating rules, role catalog, round workflow, work-tree rules, Project Control overview, node records, and accepted Editor browser smoke packet at Project Control commit 739d19d452bdb5151ec030db96a9247da0a29ae5 before editing.

items.label: Validate that the existing browser smoke evidence supports only a bounded local loopback compatibility claim.
items.evidenceTarget: The supporting Project Control evidence packet cites exact Editor, Backend, and Core commits plus owner checks and remaining risks.
items.verificationNote: Used doc-editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-2026-08-27 and evidence-editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-2026-08-27, which cite Editor ad0dbf7b81f483cb73c19ed28c3fd8fcbd68c6e4, Backend 42cc1040c959a16647b7e797929358c401ccfa38, Core 77b9e181d1fb43bf69d725108ede664578a07a45, browser smoke output, focused retained evidence, and Editor owner gates.

items.label: Classify the narrowest safe promotion scope and explicitly preserve broader unknowns.
items.evidenceTarget: The promotion target is a bounded child node, not the FlowDoc parent or broad Core, Editor, or Backend nodes.
items.verificationNote: Created the flowdoc-browser-compatibility child node as current only for the accepted local loopback browser smoke path; left FlowDoc planned and Core, Editor, and Backend unknown.

items.label: Update only the bounded compatibility node, document/evidence links, and FlowDoc system map entry.
items.evidenceTarget: Canonical records and the FlowDoc system map point to the bounded claim without attaching it to broad repository nodes.
items.verificationNote: Added flowdoc-browser-compatibility node, current-state document, promotion evidence, Work/Phase/Checklist records, and a FlowDoc system-map inventory row. No Editor, Backend, Core, or FlowDoc parent truthState was promoted.

items.label: Run focused and full Project Control gates after the map promotion.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control generated index, semantic checks, focused roadmap test, and full gate pass in the worktree and merged main.
items.verificationNote: This checklist item is satisfied only after npm run generate, npm run check:data, focused project-roadmap-work-queue test, and npm run check pass in the worktree and merged main.

items.label: Record the promotion evidence and remaining risks without changing product behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-flowdoc-bounded-browser-compatibility-promotion-2026-08-27 records the supported claim, exclusions, checks, and intentionally unchanged truth.
items.verificationNote: Recorded a Project Control-owned evidence summary that points back to the accepted browser smoke packet and states deployed, cross-browser, broad-corpus, accessibility, visual-regression, npm-audit, bundle-size, and product-readiness claims remain unpromoted.
